title: Boundary Load Maps: Testing Declared Skill Interfaces by Differentiated Atom Restoration
hook: Schema-valid cross-paper swaps of GRASP- and SkillRL-style components into a non-native SkillStack receiver can lose ALFWorld goal success that no declared-schema difference predicts, yet is recovered atom-by-atom at consumer read points — a measured extension of interface-induced trajectory censoring from hidden tool-call streams to declared skill boundaries; we test whether declared interface coverage, not behavior, is the load-bearing axis of portability. The measured surprise is asymmetric: restoring undeclared-but-consumed atoms moves downstream success, while restoring declared atoms does not.
hook_shape_rationale: Shape (a), surprising empirical reveal: the named metrics are per-atom presence effects on ALFWorld goal success and the share of the swap delta recovered by restoring undeclared versus declared strata; the non-obvious regime split is that declared-schema coverage (the axis closest_adjacent work certifies portability on) predicts none of the recovery. Shape (b) was viable — the tacit assumption is that a boundary declared before transplantation is behaviorally sufficient — but the reveal is sharper than the reframe because the falsifying measurement (restore real recorded atoms, score by the environment oracle) is the contribution, not the restatement of the assumption. The reveal is framed as a measured extension of interface-censoring evidence rather than a first demonstration of the phenomenon: arxiv:2609.03966v1 already documents frozen-seed 0.00-versus-0.96 adapter-swap censoring with a template × parser interaction localization, so the contribution is the falsifying measurement instrument and the declaredness-partitioned completeness certificate, which that line of evidence does not construct.

gap_closure.gap: Across the retrieved frontier leaves, no paper tests whether a component boundary declared before transplantation captures every behaviorally load-bearing dependency rather than merely making the system executable — stakes: the field's modularity and portability conclusions may rest on an unexamined interface-completeness assumption, invalidating comparisons whenever hidden state, evidence, failure, or update semantics cross the declared boundary.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed in two halves: the heterogeneous_decomposition move partitions the append-only consumer-read atom census by declaredness, read-status, and channel-domain type and applies a tailored canonical probe per stratum (presence arm with real recorded values, content arm only where a state- or registry-grounded finite alternative exists, fail-closed abstention otherwise), producing the per-stratum load map; the assumption_audit companion consumes that map and falsifies the predeclared-boundary sufficiency assumption wherever a load-bearing stratum is undeclared, pivoting to a schema-later completeness criterion that must carry every oracle-certified stratum. Corpus support is thin for agent-skill boundaries; C04's closest exemplars are differentiated compression of over-provisioned artifacts, so the audit should judge this against the cluster's abstract partition-and-differentiate moves.

core_mechanism: Fix the frozen finite population U = (task t, seed s, implementation i, receiver r, neighbor n) from the two existing manifests configs/p0_tasks_picktwo9.json and configs/p0_tasks_hard.json crossed with the repository's GRASP and SkillRL A-slot variants and fidelity labels, retaining every rejection, timeout, and non-completion as an outcome. For each execution u the append-only tracer records every boundary atom a = (channel c in {payload, state, evidence, authority/update, version}, key k, recorded native value v*, read locus l, event class e) at the moment the receiver actually consumes it, and the atom census is the input object. Partition the census by two discriminating properties: (i) whether a is declared in the repository's docs/canonical_interface_v1.md, and (ii) whether the channel admits a canonical content alternative z != v* constructed only from the typed registry and the frozen ALFWorld state — a Boolean complement if the existing parser admits it, another member of a declared finite enum, or a state-admitted same-role symbol (e.g., the other present object when the native value names one); singleton and unregistered channels form the fail-closed stratum on which no content claim is made. For every atom that is undeclared or whose value differs between the native-reference and crossed runs, run the presence arm from the crossed-cell run's saved pre-consumption ALFWorld state at that atom's read/default/drop event: the side-car re-injects the recorded real native value v* at the crossed-cell read locus without rewriting producer or neighbor code, the un-restored arm is the crossed-cell continuation, and the paired oracle-scored presence effect is Delta_a = mean over seeds s in S of (goal_success(restored) - goal_success(un-restored)) with R_rep = 8 saved-state replays per arm under temperature-0 decoding of the frozen receiver and environment, so the replays are identical re-executions serving as a determinism guard (a cell whose replays diverge is aborted and reported), a fixed repetition count whose selection rule is pilot-cell stabilization of the exact paired mean; atoms whose native and crossed values coincide are presence-inert by construction and receive Delta_a = 0 without replay; atoms with no read/default/drop event in the crossed cell are recorded cross-absent and excluded from the probe population. Delta_a signs are preserved, and a negative Delta_a still counts as load-bearing (anti-recovery effect), with 'recovery of D' language restricted to positive-Delta_a atoms. Where property (ii) is canonical, a content arm injects z through the unchanged parser and consumer-admission path from the same crossed-cell saved state and records whether Delta_a(z) is not equal to Delta_a(v*) on the deterministic replay lattice, classifying the atom as content-sensitive versus presence-sensitive, with an abstention record when both arms are zero; where not canonical, the atom is reported load-bearing at presence level or abstained, never scored against a manufactured null. The load map marks atom a load-bearing iff Delta_a != 0 on the executed seed set (sign preserved) or, for canonical strata, the content arm classified it content-sensitive; per-stratum joint-mask arms (restoring all value-differing atoms of a stratum jointly, O(#strata x R_rep) per cell) localize jointly-required load that per-atom arms cannot see, and the assumption_audit companion then tests the sufficiency assumption: any load-bearing atom or joint-load-bearing stratum absent from the declared schema falsifies predeclared-boundary completeness on U, and the induced schema-later interface must carry exactly the oracle-certified load-bearing strata. The swap delta D(r,n) = mean goal success of the native-reference cell minus mean goal success of the crossed cell is accounted per cell as the sum of Delta_a over certified per-atom load-bearing atoms plus the sum of J_s over certified joint-load-bearing strata plus a residual epsilon(r,n) reported as definitional bookkeeping left unlabeled only for cells whose joint coverage of D is certified (otherwise epsilon is reported as an uncertified remainder with no attribution label), with no factorial main-effect coefficients and no sampling-inference interval; completion is reported separately because it is treatment-affected. Jointly-required atoms — value-differing atoms whose per-atom presence effects are zero but whose per-stratum joint-mask effect J_s is nonzero — are purged from the inert bulk so the negative control can never re-inject them. Every verdict is exact and finite-population over U under the temperature-0 replay contract stated above, the not-falsified completeness certificate is emitted only after the full-joint restoration arm's coverage of D is certified (cells with D != 0 whose full-joint arm does not cover D are reported incomplete-by-joint-coverage, never certified), and nothing is certified for channels the tracer cannot observe at explicit reads — prompt-internal consumption is censored and abstained by design rather than assumed complete.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. SkillStack's JSONL tracer plus explicit adapter instrumentation can observe every boundary value that receiver modules read through declared adapter and control objects; reason: repository-level explicit adapters exist, but prompt-internal latent consumption is not directly observable and is censored by design — untested — falsification target.
P2. Re-injecting an observed real native atom at its recorded consumer read locus can change downstream behavior without rewriting the producer or neighbor; reason: receiver prompts condition on carried values — untested — falsification target, and the load-bearing variable the campaign pivots on.
P3. The typed registry plus frozen ALFWorld state supply a canonical alternative z for some channels (Boolean complement when admitted, declared enum member, same-role object symbol) but not for numeric/schema ranges or singletons; reason: enumeration is state-grounded for object roles and type-grounded for booleans/enums, while numeric ranges have no canonical constructor, so per-channel abstention is required rather than a uniform null.
P4. ALFWorld's environment goal predicate is an evaluand-independent oracle for the named household tasks; reason: it scores completed states without consulting the evaluated component, adapter, or an LLM judge.
P5. Source-native, source-variant, reconstructed, and blocked fidelity labels remain distinct strata; reason: the experiment preserves available paper/source behavior and never upgrades a reconstruction to paper-faithful evidence.
Observation-model premise. The empirical population is the complete Cartesian set of tasks in the two named manifests crossed with a preregistered seed list and the admitted implementation/receiver/neighbor cells; the atom census is observed only at explicit consumer reads, so sampling is complete for explicit read points in this frozen finite population but censored for prompt-internal consumption — the load map abstains on censored loci and never claims boundary completeness beyond observable reads.
Estimand. Over U, the exact finite-population per-atom presence effect Delta_a (paired difference in ALFWorld goal success between restored and un-restored arms from the same saved state, averaged over the executed seed set), per-stratum joint-mask effects J_s, per-stratum aggregates of Delta_a, and the per-cell accounting identity D(r,n) = sum over certified per-atom load-bearing atoms of Delta_a + sum over certified joint-load-bearing strata of J_s + epsilon(r,n), with epsilon reported as unlabeled bookkeeping only for cells whose joint coverage of D is certified; all quantities descriptive and exact on executed cells, with no randomization-interval or certificate-level error claims.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: The runnable naive version is to diff native and crossed traces at consumer reads, re-inject every differing atom jointly through one carrier, and call the declared interface incomplete whenever joint restoration recovers success. Branch (i): the naive version silently relies on the false premise that the trace-diff set is the dependency census and that its atoms carry uniform joint load — in fact most consumed atoms are behaviorally inert and only a sparse minority is load-bearing, so uniform joint restoration cannot say which atom carries the effect, presence-dependence is conflated with content-dependence, and channels with no trace diff but receiver-required semantics escape measurement. The confrontation is the differentiated per-atom presence probe with real recorded values, the declaredness- and channel-domain partition, per-stratum joint masks that localize jointly-required load without exhaustive subset search, and fail-closed abstention, making the sparse load map plus certified joint coverage the identification object rather than a uniform restoration sweep. Standard-tool follow-up: per-atom restoration resembles delta debugging and feature ablation, but the domain-specific structure is that the certificate requires only positive localization of load-bearing strata plus certified joint coverage of the swap delta, not exhaustive 2^k subset minimization over every co-dependent atom subset (per-atom arms localize first-order effects and per-stratum joint masks localize the joint remainder), the census is observational at fixed read loci rather than a failure-triggering input space, and the constraint set — no producer/neighbor rewrites, no LLM judge, environment oracle only, exact descriptive reporting, saved-state replay — rules out the textbook wrappers; the load map also does not reduce to the flagged lineage nodes: it is not specification mining (no invariant inference), not conformance testing (no receiver-written suite), not cross-implementation differential testing (no same-input output comparison as the claim), not factorial design (no ANOVA-style coefficients; per-cell exact accounting only), and not a schema-first contract (the induced interface is produced after measurement and only for certified strata).
BLOCK 3 — Design rationale: (a) the selection is anchor-only with a chained companion because the interface-completeness measurement is the prerequisite the attribution and portability gaps presuppose — separating implementation main effects or certifying portability before a load-bearing census exists would build on the unexamined assumption this gap names, so depth on one gap plus the audit pivot beats parallel legs; (b) alternatives considered and rejected: a uniform confound-isolating diagnostic with a single exclusion/alternative null (rejected because canonical alternative values do not exist for registered-range numeric and singleton channels, so any uniform null is non-constructible and would force silent claim narrowing), a transport-certificate reframing with randomization intervals (rejected because the frozen finite population admits no exchangeability basis for such intervals), and making the schema-later interface induction the anchor (rejected because induction is the pivot output of this instrument, not a separable deliverable).
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Freeze the cell manifest: task lists from configs/p0_tasks_picktwo9.json and configs/p0_tasks_hard.json, a preregistered nonempty seed list S, GRASP and SkillRL source commits with fidelity labels, receiver/neighbor settings, prompts, budgets, and docs/canonical_interface_v1.md as the declared-schema baseline; output an immutable manifest and hash record.
2. Extend src/skillstack/tracing/jsonl.py to emit boundary atoms (channel, key, recorded native value, read locus, event class) for every raw read, default, drop, rejection, no-op, fallback, and version event at explicit adapter consumer points; output an append-only native boundary census for each execution unit.
3. Run each admitted GRASP-proposer and SkillRL-updater A-slot variant in its native-reference cell and in the matched crossed cell (receiver/neighbor/task/seed fixed, existing adapter unchanged), every cell run under the same temperature-0 decoding and R_rep = 8 replays per seed as the probe arms, so D(r,n) and the Delta_a terms live on one deterministic replay lattice; output paired traces, completion states, ALFWorld goal outcomes, and the crossed-cell swap delta D(r,n).
4. Build the typed intervention registry from runtime type/schema metadata plus the frozen ALFWorld object/state registry, enumerating for each channel the canonical alternatives z (Boolean complement if parser-admitted, declared enum members, same-role object symbols present in the saved state) and passing each candidate through the existing parser and consumer-admission path; output the admitted-alternative list and the rejected-alternative log, and mark channels with an empty or non-canonical domain as fail-closed.
5. From the crossed-cell run's saved pre-consumption ALFWorld state at the atom's read/default/drop event, run the presence arm by re-injecting the recorded real native value v* at the crossed-cell read locus with R_rep = 8 temperature-0 saved-state replays per arm (the replays are identical re-executions serving as a determinism guard; a cell whose replays diverge is aborted and reported); the un-restored arm is the crossed-cell continuation; atoms with no read/default/drop event in the crossed cell are recorded cross-absent and excluded from the probe population; output the paired oracle-scored presence effect Delta_a = mean over seeds s in S of (goal_success(restored) - goal_success(un-restored)) per atom (this injection propagates through the unchanged receiver to its generated actions and the environment outcome, which is what Delta_a scores). When the native and crossed values of an atom coincide the presence arm is a no-op (restored == un-restored arm) and the atom is presence-inert by construction: assign Delta_a = 0 without replay and exclude it from the measured-inert bulk and from negative-control cells. Delta_a signs are preserved: a negative Delta_a (restoration moving success away from the native-reference level) is an anti-recovery effect, is reported with its sign, and still counts as load-bearing for declaredness verdicts; 'recovery of D' language refers only to atoms with positive Delta_a.
6. For canonical-content strata only, run the content arm injecting z through the unchanged parser and admission path from the same crossed-cell saved state; output Delta_a(z) and classify the atom content-sensitive iff Delta_a(z) != Delta_a(v*) on the deterministic replay lattice and presence-sensitive otherwise; when BOTH arms are zero the equality is forced (joint dependence blocks both injections) and cannot distinguish inertness from joint dependence, so emit an abstention record instead of a classification; for fail-closed strata emit an abstention record instead of an effect.
7. Aggregate the census into the load map: mark each atom load-bearing iff Delta_a != 0 on the executed seed set (sign preserved) or, for canonical strata, the content arm classified it content-sensitive, then stratify by declaredness and channel domain. For every stratum whose per-atom effects are all zero while the cell's D != 0, run per-stratum joint-mask arms: from the same saved pre-consumption states, restore all value-differing atoms of that stratum jointly through one carrier (one joint arm per stratum per seed, O(#strata x R_rep) replayed executions per cell, inside the declared compute budget) and score the joint effect J_s = mean over seeds s in S of (goal_success(joint-restored) - goal_success(un-restored)); a stratum with J_s != 0 is joint-load-bearing. Output the per-stratum load map (per-atom effects and joint-mask effects with exact per-cell counts), plus the set of certified load-bearing atoms that the declared schema does not contain.
8. Compute the per-cell accounting identity D(r,n) = sum of Delta_a over certified per-atom load-bearing atoms + sum of J_s over certified joint-load-bearing strata + residual epsilon(r,n), reporting completion separately; epsilon is definitional bookkeeping (the remainder D minus the certified sums; it can be negative, equal D, or carry interaction slack) and is not attribution evidence: report D, the certified sums, and epsilon as separate quantities with epsilon left unlabeled ONLY for cells whose joint coverage of D is certified in step 10 (otherwise epsilon is reported as an uncertified remainder with no attribution label); output exact descriptive tables per receiver/neighbor cell with no randomization intervals.
9. Run the two controls: an inert-stratum carrier that re-injects real recorded atoms from the measured-inert bulk at their own loci (the bulk holds only atoms whose probe manipulated a differing value and measured Delta_a = 0 and that belong to no joint-load-bearing stratum certified by the step-7 joint masks, so the negative control can never re-inject jointly-required atoms; downstream success must not move, and a cell whose measured-inert bulk is empty records the control as not-run), and a full native-payload restoration as the oracle upper bound, which doubles as the full-joint restoration arm whose coverage of D gates step 10; output both for every cell.
10. Emit the completeness verdict per declared boundary: falsified where undeclared load-bearing strata exist under either the per-atom probe or the joint-mask probe, abstained where the probe population is empty (no crossed-cell read/default/drop events) or the only undeclared strata are prompt-internal-censored or fail-closed with cross-cell-identical values, and not-falsified only when either D = 0, or the full-joint restoration arm's coverage of D is certified (the positive control recovers D within its measured coverage) and no undeclared stratum carries load; a cell with D != 0 whose full-joint arm does not cover D is reported incomplete-by-joint-coverage — a falsification finding, never a certificate. The schema-later interface criterion is defined as coverage of the oracle-certified load-bearing strata and aligns with the falsification experiment's own falsifier (the undeclared-stratum recovery share must be positive wherever the swap delta is positive), output as the induced interface candidate with its coverage table.
falsification_prediction: Run the implemented GRASP-versus-SkillRL A-slot swaps and the existing retrieval-by-composition SkillStack cells on the two frozen ALFWorld manifests with the configured backend, measuring ALFWorld goal success, completion, and per-atom presence effects under un-restored, declared-stratum-restored, undeclared-stratum-restored, inert-stratum-restored, and full-native-payload arms. If the mechanism is real, the load-bearing variable — the presence effect Delta_a of undeclared-but-consumed atoms aggregated under the stratum mask selecting undeclared load-bearing atoms — moves downstream goal success toward the native-reference level, so the undeclared-stratum recovery share of D(r,n) is positive and exceeds the declared-stratum recovery share, which stays near zero; completion is reported separately. The negative control re-injects atoms from the measured-inert stratum with identical carrier mechanics and real recorded values at their own loci, and the predicted effect on ALFWorld goal success is no movement away from the un-restored baseline — if inert restoration moves success as much as load-bearing restoration, the load map is a carrier artifact and the idea is falsified. The positive control is full native-payload restoration, which must recover most of D(r,n) and bracket the undeclared-stratum share as the upper bound of what any single stratum can explain. The idea is falsified if no undeclared load-bearing stratum exists in any executed cell (the declared schema is already behaviorally complete on U), if undeclared and declared restoration shares are indistinguishable on downstream success, or if the undeclared-stratum share is not positive wherever the swap delta is positive.
compute_budget: Approximately 24 GPU-days on 80GB-class GPUs for the full paired cell grid, saved-state replays (native, crossed, presence, content, inert, and full-payload arms at R_rep = 8), census featurization, accounting tables, and iteration over two task manifests; plus approximately $3,000 inference/API dollars for the full campaign including failed cells, retries, and a backend-sensitivity rerun — comfortably inside the ~150 GPU-day / $10k envelope.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: AgentSquare standardizes each module to a uniform four-part IO interface and then searches 1,050 recombinations inside one workflow, whereas this candidate never normalizes semantics into a uniform boundary and instead measures which undeclared atoms at actual consumer reads change ALFWorld outcomes in frozen native-versus-crossed cells.

SkCC lowers one SKILL.md source into a typed SkIR and emits framework-native renderings, certifying portability after compilation, whereas this candidate performs no semantic compilation and tests the completeness of any declared representation by oracle-scored presence restoration, so semantic loss that survives SkIR emission remains measurable rather than assumed away.

GraSP substitutes skill nodes whenever declared precondition-effect coverage satisfies downstream requirements in a typed DAG, whereas this candidate tests that coverage assumption itself: an atom is load-bearing only if restoring its real recorded value at the consumer read changes ALFWorld goal success, independent of any declared contract.

SkillAlign fixes the task, backend, and candidate skills and varies only the exposure interface, whereas this candidate holds exposure fixed, swaps the paper-native implementations and neighboring modules, and attributes outcome changes to individual boundary atoms whose presence effects are oracle-scored.

SkillOps audits declared P-O-A-V-F contracts and graph health over skill libraries, whereas this candidate treats every declared contract as a hypothesis and certifies load-bearing dependencies by environment-oracle restoration effects, failing closed on channels where no canonical contrast exists.

ACES estimates whole-skill lift by adding or withholding a skill under a fixed harness, whereas this candidate adds and withholds individual boundary atoms at their recorded read points inside a transplant, isolating interface-completeness effects that whole-skill lift cannot resolve.

Interface-Induced Trajectory Censoring shows frozen-seed adapter swaps can hide entire tool-call streams (0.00-versus-0.96) and localizes the loss to a template × parser interaction where repairing one side of the contract buys nothing, whereas this candidate does not stop at documenting censoring: it re-injects single recorded boundary atoms at consumer read loci from saved pre-consumption state, partitions the load map by declaredness, and converts the finding into a completeness certificate against the declared schema — that paper measures the phenomenon, the load map makes its boundary-completeness consequences testable per declared interface.

what_step_was_missed: GraSP made substitution contingent on declared precondition-effect coverage in a typed DAG, but it never constructed the measurement primitive that would make that coverage testable: an oracle-scored per-atom presence probe that re-injects real recorded native values at actual consumer read loci from saved states, which is the step required to detect load-bearing dependencies the declared effects omit.
